title: Multiple Criteria Decision Making Under XORness
abstract: arXiv:2611.25652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How should we make decisions under XORness? XORness is a class of uncertainty arising from indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy. We develop a multiple criteria decision making framework that preserves XORness throughout the decision process. We define XOR numbers and prove their fundamental arithmetic and algebraic properties. Building on these results, we extend the deterministic decision matrix to an XOR decision matrix and introduce a compatible normalization procedure. Further, we propose an additive XOR aggregation operator, which preserves indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy inherent in evaluations. In addition, we introduce an axiomatic XORness measure that quantifies the degree of uncertainty associated with global performance scores and develop a performance--XORness index to rank alternatives. We prove that this index induces a total preorder over the set of alternatives and identify the conditions for preserving dom

translated_title: XOR性（异或性）下的多准则决策
translated_abstract: 我们应该如何在XOR性下做出决策？XOR性是一类源于不定性、排他性和犹豫性的不确定性。我们开发了一个在整个决策过程中保持XOR性的多准则决策框架。我们定义了XOR数并证明了其基本的算术与代数性质。基于这些结果，我们将确定性决策矩阵扩展为XOR决策矩阵，并引入了相容的规范化方法。此外，我们提出了一种加性XOR聚合算子，该算子能够保留评估中固有的不定性、排他性和犹豫性。同时，我们引入了一个公理化的XOR性度量来量化与全局绩效得分相关的不确定性程度，并开发了一个绩效-XOR性指数用于对备选方案进行排序。我们证明该指数在备选方案集合上诱导出完全前序，并给出了保持支配关系的条件。
tldr: 本文提出了一个在决策全过程中保留XOR性（不定性、排他性与犹豫性）的多准则决策框架，通过定义XOR数、构建XOR决策矩阵、设计加性XOR聚合算子以及绩效-XOR性指数，实现对备选方案的合理排序。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a multiple criteria decision making framework that preserves XORness (indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy) throughout the decision process, via XOR numbers, XOR decision matrices, an additive XOR aggregation operator, and a performance-XORness index for ranking alternatives.
